# Model App Protocol (MAP)

> Apps that are also MCP servers. One typed object — `defineApp({ entities, actions, pages, fragments, agents, … })` from `modelapp` — becomes a JSON manifest (for hosts that draw the app natively) and a plain, conformant MCP server with tools, annotations and MCP Apps views (for ChatGPT, Claude and any MCP client). No MCP extension required.

## Start here

- [AI guide](ai-guide.md): the complete single-file reference for coding agents — the whole `defineApp` shape, the rules, the common mistakes, a full example. Read this one file to build an app.

## More

- [Specification](spec.md): the manifest, kinds and cross-app references, the generated MCP server, enforcement, conformance, workspace hosts across apps (normative, short)
- [Quickstart](quickstart.md): Next.js in 5 minutes (`npx modelapp init`), a day to ship; standalone Node; tests
- [Auth](auth.md): your sign-in as the authorization server, your `auth.resolve`; recipes for better-auth, Clerk, Auth0, WorkOS
- [CRM example](examples/crm.md): Next.js, better-auth, Drizzle; code in `examples/modelapp/crm/modelapp/app.ts`
- [Warehouse example](examples/warehouse.md): Next.js, better-auth, plain SQL; code in `examples/modelapp/warehouse/lib/modelapp.ts`
- JSON Schema of the manifest: `packages/modelapp/spec/schema/modelapp.schema.json`
- The kinds of this version (person, organization, event, task, document, product, order): `packages/modelapp/spec/kinds.json`
